review_method: Read complete controller, full operational diff, preparation and unchanged own-job guard as source text. Passive stdlib hashing only; no candidate/guard/controller import or process registry/Lean invocation.

corrected_finding.resolution: Producer corrected only preparation schema; controller unchanged. Root approval copied from the prior template would have been refused before source dispatch.

control_review.mode_one: One HT -j2 worker plus at most one foreign Lean descended from an optional exact PID/creationUTC/commandSHA/sourceSHA-bound A000 dispatcher. Zero companion is accepted. Detailed identity rechecked before each new HT source.
control_review.mode_two: At most two own HT -j2 workers; companion must be null, root asserts actual A000 slot returned, and all foreign Lean/unbound A000 dispatchers are refused.
control_review.global_limit: Toolhelp own-tree count and detailed pre-dispatch CIM identity enforce approved scheduler lease/max2 at snapshots. Does not reserve RAM or terminate foreign children; unexpected processes lead to drain/checkpoint.
control_review.scope: Only manifest-bound still-cold independent Chunk sources. No automatic nine remaining granular, eleven whole imports, original/supplement endpoint audit, native build or storage operation.
control_review.history: Prior actual rows remain byte-semantically identical as the full ordered prefix. Previous resource settings and policy are archived; new rows explicitly retain literal -j2 and LEAN_NUM_THREADS=2 without relabeling -j1 history.
control_review.guard: Unchanged per-child suspended-before-own-job assignment, 6GiB private cap, 4GB/6GiB physical/5GiB commit initial and 1GB/3GiB physical/1GiB commit continuous floors;3600s. Parent repeats initial gates before dispatch.
control_review.hold: Global root hold rechecked after CIM immediately before worker submission; active workers finish under guards; no further sources dispatch; parent alone atomically writes receipt.
control_review.no_attempt: Guard gate without invocation reinserts same cold source and waits2s without a fake build row. No log files are opened by the guard in this state, so deterministic per-source log prefix remains cold on the next attempt.
control_review.failures: Actual source failures remain explicit and are never retried automatically; independent chunks may continue. Guard stops/worker operational exceptions prevent new dispatch and drain existing work. Nonzero actual failures cannot produce a scientific PASS.

qualification_limits: This is a static operational peer review, not execution authorization or selected theorem verification.

End-of-controller sources_ready rechecks all original source hashes and preserved prior artifact hashes, while new output hashes are measured on completion. A later root qualification must independently rehash all new output/log/row identities.
Final global registry is recorded, not an exclusive OS lock. Root qualification should inspect any final registry violations; raw final scheduled source checkpoint is never a theorem PASS.
R100/R101 six selected audit observations are separate already-completed evidence and are not inserted into canonical source history by this controller.
writes: Only this new additive read-only review JSON.
